title: InvenTrust Properties Corp. Reports 2022 First Quarter Results
summary: InvenTrust Properties Corp. (“InvenTrust” or the “Company”) (NYSE: IVT) today reported financial and operating results for the period ended March 31, 2022 and provided updated guidance for 2022. For the three months ended March 31, 2022, the Company reported Net Income of $9.5 million, or $0.14 per diluted share, compared to a Net Loss of $0.1 million, or $0.00 per diluted share, for the three months ended March 31, 2021. First Quarter 2022 Highlights: NAREIT FFO for the quarter of $0.47 per diluted share Core FFO for the quarter of $0.43 per diluted share Pro Rata Same Property Net Operating Income (“NOI”) increased 12.2% for the three month period Leased Occupancy as of March 31, 2022 of 94.4% Executed 68 leases totaling approximately 183,000 square feet of pro rata GLA, of which 125,000 square feet was executed at a blended comparable lease spread of 5.0% Net Debt-to-Adjusted EBITDA of 5.7x at March 31, 2022 Established an at-the-market (“ATM”) equity offering program of up to $250
